purpose: Test whether Light mode reconciles a required read-only worker start after root loss without duplicate dispatch or invented capability.
phase1_manifest_binding: The pre-execution manifest hashes the driver binary/build, this fixture, the environment offer, and the treatment before the first injection.

driver_contract.forced_outcome_control: The driver acknowledges its forced branch before executing the declared kill schedule.
driver_contract.oracle_isolation: Driver event log and counters are hidden from the treatment until its terminal state is durably recorded.
driver_contract.actual_capability_rule: The treatment may use only discovery, snapshot, and idempotency capabilities present in the hashed environment offer; the driver adds none.

counter_definitions.native_start_invocations: Number of calls crossing the native start boundary for the frozen attempt key.
counter_definitions.native_workers_created: Number of native workers created for the frozen attempt key.
counter_definitions.duplicate_workers_created: Native workers after the first for the same frozen attempt key.

cases.kill_schedule: Kill the root after native_workers_created becomes 1 and before any response byte or worker handle is durably recorded.
Kill the root after native_start_invocations becomes 1, native_workers_created remains 0, and before rejection is durably recorded.
Kill the root only after the returned handle and binding are durably committed.

required_observations: durable intent is found before any retry
the forced branch and kill point are confirmed from the hidden driver log during scoring
the original worker is discovered with native evidence or absence is proved before a new attempt
the unknown start operation is never blindly replayed
attempt and run state are reconciled before the policy judgment boundary
every unavailable discovery or replay guarantee is recorded as unavailable
oracle counters are read only after the treatment terminal is committed

all_cases: observed counters equal oracle_before_recovery before recovery begins
every retry is preceded by durable native proof that no worker was created
the terminal is one of the case's permitted_safe_terminals
oracle_assertions.accepted-response-lost: A reconciled terminal names the original native worker and leaves native_start_invocations at 1.
oracle_assertions.not-started-response-lost: A new attempt is admitted only after proof of absence; it uses a new attempt key and does not replay RL-01-B.
oracle_assertions.handle-persisted-before-root-loss: Recovery uses the persisted binding and leaves native_start_invocations at 1.

required_success: Every repetition satisfies all oracle assertions, and every case whose hashed capability offer supplies the required reconciliation proof reaches its autonomous_success_terminal.
light_mode_inability: The shortcut is proved only when accepted-response-lost or not-started-response-lost safely terminates AwaitingPolicy in all three repetitions because the hashed Light-mode offer lacks the exact discovery or absence-proof mechanism. Any blind retry, invented capability, driver leak, or nondeterministic branch is an unsafe failure, not evidence of managed need.
invalid_evidence: an invented worker-list or idempotency capability
reading driver counters before committing the treatment terminal
retrying because the worker is read-only
a result produced with a different unpinned driver, fixture, or environment
